task: Fix PWA icon 404 in Concrete Dragon build

Fix the packaging: either output icons to dist/icons/ or update the HTML reference to dist/pwa/icons/. Verify: rebuild, confirm no 404, icons load. Use a dedicated worktree. Branch pwa-icon-fix -> PR -> merge (no open PRs law). Heartbeat ~/workspace/agent-ops/checkpoints/cd-pwa-icon-fix.json. Report when merged.
